title: Pure Subterror
summary: Subterror cards only, with staples and an automatic Extra Deck. Subterror is an EARTH Flip deck. The Subterror Behemoths flip themselves face-down once per turn, and when your last face-up monster is flipped face-down they summon themselves from the hand. Each one then fires a Flip effect when turned face-up again. Umastryx banishes a monster, Stalagmo discards a Subterror to draw two, and Ultramafus flips every other monster face-down. Subterror Nemesis Warrior mills a Behemoth, then tributes itself and another monster to summon it. The Hidden City searches a Subterror and flips one face-up on either turn, and Subterror Fiendess negates an activation by flipping a Subterror face-down. The 2019 cards lead. Subterror Guru searches any Subterror card when flipped and flips itself and another monster face-down on either turn. Subterror Succession trades a monster for a Flip monster of the same Attribute from the Deck, then Sets itself again.
